DL.notes: AZ issues REAL ID compliant DLs. Star symbol in top right corner for REAL ID.

R_AZ_001.description: Arizona DL/ID must show 'ARIZONA' in Zone I

R_AZ_002.description: REAL ID compliant AZ card must show gold star in top right

R_AZ_003.description: Under-21 AZ DL must be vertical orientation

R_AZ_004.description: AZ DL number format: one letter + 8 digits (e.g. D12345678)
R_AZ_004.note: Most AZ DL numbers. Some older formats may vary.

R_AZ_005.description: Barcode IIN must be 636004 for Arizona-issued documents

R_AZ_006.description: AZ DL address should be an Arizona address unless out-of-state mailing address

ai_check_items.note: State-specific visual checks — AI must evaluate these
items: Grand Canyon / Arizona landscape background graphic present
Arizona state outline or saguaro cactus design element present
Correct color scheme for card generation (varies by year)
Ghost image of portrait in correct position
AZ MVD issuing authority watermark/logo present
Holographic overlay consistent with AZ design
Font style consistent with known AZ DL typeface
Under-21 card shows vertical orientation AND 'UNDER 21 UNTIL [date]' prominently

field_label_conventions.note: AZ uses standard AAMVA abbreviations on card face
